generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in Multiple Transaction are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per karnataka state government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01-01-2007 and Govt letter No.PW/134/BMS /2007/dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
Earnest Money Deposit will have to be in any one of the forms as per the instructions in the financial bid document and shall have to be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of the tender.
Tenderers are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.
Department will not supply any materials, and the cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KP Procurement Portal.
The Employer reserves the rights reject one or all tender without assigning any reasons.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Chikodi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned
The Tenderer are should be present during opening of the tender and also submit the uploaded documents duly attested by the Gazetted Officer not below the Rank of Executive Engineer.
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.(As per prevailing rates GST will be Paid Separately)
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes (excluding GST) as per prevailing Government Orders.
Difference amount should submit at the time of Agreement.
Financial turover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section.
If no bid received auto extension will be done by e-proc itself for 2 days.
The contractor should employe only registered labours as per government circular No. PWD/198/HMS/2009/ Dated: 24/06/2009 as per EPF and MP act 1952. In respect of the employe
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) form practicing Chartered Account is preferred.

Appeal as per the Government Ltr No. 572/CRM/2020/PWD-COMM-1-PWD-SEC, Dtated: 09-10-2020 the appeal received in e-proc as per KTTP act/rules within the stipulated time will only the considered. Any written appeal received shall not be considered.

As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3 If the Tenderer is not ready to make aggrement, Then the EMD amount will be forfeited and tender will be rejected

As per Government Circular No. PWD/48/BMS/2022, Dated 31/05/2024 and KTPP 2000 Rules 26(A) contractor are liable for debarment if contractor does bad quality of work, if contractor fails to complete the work within stupilated period of time and also to follow all other conditions mentioned in the above said Government circular.
The work should be implemented as per electrical norms and approved specifications.

The Tenderer shall obtain similar the workdone certificate such as shifting of Pole work from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 (50% of the Amount Put to Tender i.e., Rs.2.76 Lakhs) in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer)and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid.

The Tenderer shall achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover from financial year 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs. 5.52 Lakhs (not less than the estimated cost under this contract)
The EMD of Rs. 14,000/- shall be paid in full through e-payment in favour of Executive Engineer, PWD, Chikodi Dn, Chikodi
Work Completion/Execution Period : 3 months Including Mansoon.
